_doc: TOP-BAR policy. The fleet draws its first row ONCE: libs:bottomnav's AppTopBar (ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/bottomnav, package com.diegonmarcos.superapp.bottomnav): a hamburger that opens a side drawer the current page fills (TopBarDrawer), the app's title centred, and two circular buttons at the right, AI (the shared libs:ai chat in an anchored panel) and Settings (a dropdown: Account launches Cloud Account, Configs calls the host's own Configs page). An app DECLARES it in build.json::ui.top_bar and libs:bottomnav's TopBarDecl reads it. Consumed by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-top-bar-guard.py, which fails when an app that declares ui.top_bar draws the row itself, or does not draw the declared one. Nothing in the script names an app, a path or a marker: adding a rule, a settings entry or a wiring needle is a DATA edit here.
_rule: an app that declares ui.top_bar draws it with libs:bottomnav's AppTopBar; it does not hand-roll a hamburger, a drawer, a top app bar or a Cloud Account launch.
_doc_owner: The one tree allowed to draw the bar. It must also still HOLD it (owner_must_hold): a guard whose owner was emptied would stay green for every app that copied the bar back out.
_doc_scan_prefixes: A top-level directory starting with any of these may be an app. It is checked when its build.json::ui declares top_bar, whichever app that is: a new app that declares the bar is held to the rules the day it does.
_doc_known_settings: The entries of the Settings dropdown (libs:bottomnav TopBarSettings.KNOWN). Account launches Cloud Account; Configs calls the host's own Configs page.

own-hamburger.why: an app that declares ui.top_bar draws the hamburger with AppTopBar, not with its own Menu icon

own-drawer.why: the side drawer is AppTopBar's; a page fills it with TopBarDrawer { ... } instead of drawing a drawer

own-top-app-bar.why: the first row is AppTopBar; a Material top app bar beside it is a second copy

own-account-launch.why: the Account entry launches Cloud Account through the bar's rememberAccountLauncher / AccountLaunch, once for the fleet
